quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY26 (year ended 30 June 2026): net revenue grew A$54.8 million (16%) to A$405.0 million and Underlying EBITDA increased A$32.1 million (15%) to A$248.8 million, both above FY26 guidance (A$390 to A$400 million and A$230 to A$240 million); total revenue A$496.5 million; statutory NPAT A$82.1 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Net revenue A$405.0 million (+16%); Underlying EBITDA A$248.8 million (+15%)

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Record increase in contracted utilisation of 495.3MW (202%) to 740.1MW on a pro forma basis; record Forward Order Book of 565.1MW, more than 3.2 times billing utilisation, comprising binding contracted commitments only. Contracted EBITDA is expected to be in excess of A$1.0 billion from existing contracts. CEO Craig Scroggie: FY26 was the largest contracting year in NEXTDC's history.

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Built capacity of 287.9MW at 30 June 2026, an increase of 80.0MW (38%) during FY26 (16MW at S3 Sydney, 12MW at M2 Melbourne, 42MW at M3 Melbourne, 10MW at KL1 Kuala Lumpur); billing utilisation 175.0MW, up 64.1MW (58%). 537MW of capacity under development was in progress at 30 June 2026, with a further 240MW+ of additional developments in plan.
quarterly_data.figure: Built capacity 287.9MW; billing utilisation 175.0MW; 537MW in progress

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY27 guidance (constant currency): net revenue A$615 million to A$640 million and Underlying EBITDA A$385 million to A$410 million; 197MW of the Forward Order Book expected to convert to billing in FY27 and a further 221MW in FY28, with the remaining 147MW across FY29 and FY30; capital expenditure A$5,250 million to A$5,750 million, including up to A$500 million of reimbursable customer fitout. CEO: FY27 will be a record growth year; billing is contracted to more than quadruple to 740MW by FY30.
quarterly_data.figure: FY27 net revenue A$615 million to A$640 million; Underlying EBITDA A$385 million to A$410 million; capex A$5,250 million to A$5,750 million

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY26 capital expenditure was A$3,397 million (guidance A$2,700 million to A$3,000 million), reflecting additional land acquisitions and accelerated construction to meet contracted customer delivery dates.

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook: AI, cloud, hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprise and ICT alliances are all driving strong growth in colocation and hyperscale deployments; its national metro footprint positions it for distributed AI inference where sovereignty and data gravity require workloads to co-locate with enterprise and Government data; customer options, reservations and sales pipeline are at record levels.

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: During FY26 long-term agreements were entered into with hyperscale customers for capacity at M3 Melbourne and S4 Sydney; the M3 lease commenced during FY26 and the S4 agreement was signed but had not commenced by 30 June 2026.

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Development: KL1 Kuala Lumpur opened to its foundation customer in May 2026; S4 Sydney total capacity upgraded to 365MW (250MW in progress, 115MW in planning); site for M5 Melbourne acquired with planning works commencing for up to 1.2GW of IT capacity; excavation and retaining works commenced at TK1 Tokyo.
quarterly_data.figure: S4 Sydney 365MW; M5 Melbourne up to 1.2GW

quarterly_data.quarter: NEXTDC press release: FY26 Record Results and Record FY27 Growth Guidance (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Power and regulatory: New South Wales and the Commonwealth are proposing reforms on data centre grid connections and energy use; NEXTDC says its operating portfolio and 565MW Forward Order Book are unaffected, it has written confirmation from Transgrid that its new capacity allocation policy does not apply to S4 Sydney, and power arrangements are in place across its contracted capacity.
